title: Echoes email-thread record
description: One record per archived email-thread PDF in docs/emails/. Values are copied from the file's extracted text (docs/emails-text/) or from the source archive's own folder path. Anything not literally present is null; nothing is inferred.

id.description: Path of the source PDF relative to docs/emails/, without extension.

date.description: Date/time of the FIRST message in the thread, converted from date_raw to ISO 8601 (24h). No timezone: the source export does not state one.

date_raw.description: First-message date exactly as printed in the source (e.g. 'Sun, Jul 13, 2025 at 3:05 PM').

sender.description: Sender of the first message, as printed.

recipients.description: 'To:' line of the first message, split on commas outside quotes.

subject.description: Thread subject as printed at the top of the export (wrapped lines joined with a space).

case_id.description: Case ID as stated in the thread subject, or null if the subject has none.

archive_case_folder.description: Case ID folder the source archive filed this PDF under (04_LEDGER_ARCHIVE/*/CASES/<id>/), or null. May differ from case_id.

echo_label.description: Echo folder in the source archive path (e.g. 'Echo6').

message_count.description: 'N messages' count printed at the top of the export.

source_file.description: Path to the primary source PDF, relative to repository root.

text_file.description: Path to the extracted plain text, relative to repository root.

summary.description: 1-3 neutral, factual English sentences written from the thread text in docs/emails-text/ (who wrote, what was asked or claimed, what support replied). Not extracted by the build script: maintained in data/email_summaries.json and merged by analysis/scripts/build_emails_json.py. Quoted phrases are copied from the thread. Null if not yet written.
